T.FROM_DATE > TO_DATE(#FROM_DATE:VARCHAR#,'DD/MM/YYYY')

upper(T.CONTENT) like upper('%$CONTENT$%')

sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO NOTICE_INFO (ID, TITLE, CONTENT, CPNY_ID, FROM_DATE, TO_DATE, ACTIVITY, FILE_NAME, FILE_URL, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, COLOR_FLAG) VALUES (#NOTICE_NO:VARCHAR#, #TITLE:VARCHAR#, #CONTENT:VARCHAR#, #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#, TO_DATE(#FROM_DATE:VARCHAR#, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), TO_DATE(#TO_DATE:VARCHAR#, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 1, #FILE_NAME:VARCHAR#, #FILE_URL:VARCHAR#, SYSDATE, #CREATE_BY:VARCHAR#, #COLOR_FLAG:VARCHAR#)
sqlMap.update: UPDATE NOTICE_INFO T SET T.TITLE = #TITLE#, T.CONTENT = #CONTENT#, T.FROM_DATE = TO_DATE(#FROM_DATE#, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), T.TO_DATE = TO_DATE(#TO_DATE#, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), T.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID#, T.UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, T.UPDATED_BY = #adminID# WHERE T.ID = #ID#
sqlMap.delete: DELETE FROM NOTICE_INFO T WHERE T.ID = #ID#
DELETE FROM NOTICE_INFO T WHERE SYSDATE > ADD_MONTHS(T.TO_DATE, CEIL(T.PERIOD * 12)) AND T.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID#
